description: Fix the password visibility toggle logic in two areas of the application: the sign-up form and edge functions secrets management. Ensure that button labels accurately reflect the action they will perform, and implement proper security defaults for sensitive data.
functional_requirements: Update the sign-up form password field so the toggle button shows 'Show password' when the password is hidden and 'Hide password' when the password is visible
Implement a security-first approach for edge functions secrets where all secret values are hidden by default using bullet point masking
Add independent visibility toggle functionality for each edge function secret with appropriate eye/eye-off icons
Ensure tooltips display 'Hidden' when secret values are masked and show the actual value when visible
